CREATE PROCEDURE BNKM.SP_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT_CCD
AS
BEGIN

WITH TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT AS(
  SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CustomerAccountId,LimitTypeId ORDER BY InsertDttm DESC ) RN, * FROM (
SELECT * FROM (
	-- Credit Limit -- CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT -- CRDACCT_CRLIMIT
	SELECT
		BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AS CustomerAccountId
		,'Credit Limit' AS LimitTypeId
		,CASE
			WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT = 0 THEN '19000101' ELSE BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT END AS [Timestamp]
		,BCC.CRDACCT_CRLIMIT AS LimitAmount
		,CASE
            WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP = 0 THEN '19000101' ELSE BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP END AS [LimitEndTimestamp]
		,BCC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,BCC.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
		,BCCD.RECORD_STATUS
	FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACCP_DELTA BCCD
	LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACCP BCC
	ON BCCD.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR = BCC.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR AND BCCD.CRDACCT_NBR = BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AND BCC.isLatest = '1'
	
	UNION ALL
	
	-- Temporary Credit Limit -- CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EFF -- CRDACCT_TEMP_CRLIMIT
	SELECT
		BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AS CustomerAccountId
		,'Temporary Credit Limit' AS LimitTypeId
		,CASE
			WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT = 0 THEN '19000101' ELSE BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT END AS [Timestamp]
		,BCC.CRDACCT_TEMP_CRLIMIT AS LimitAmount
		,CASE
            WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP = 0 THEN '19000101' ELSE BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP END AS [LimitEndTimestamp]
		,BCC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,BCC.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
		,BCCD.RECORD_STATUS
	FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACCP_DELTA BCCD
	LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACCP BCC
	ON BCCD.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR = BCC.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR AND BCCD.CRDACCT_NBR = BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AND BCC.isLatest = '1'
	
	UNION ALL
	
	-- Permanent Credit Limit -- CRDACCT_TIME_MAINT -- CRDACCT_PERM_CRLIMIT 
	SELECT
		BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AS CustomerAccountId
		,'Permanent Credit Limit' AS LimitTypeId
		,CASE
			WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT = 0 THEN '19000101' ELSE BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT END AS [Timestamp]
		,BCC.CRDACCT_PERM_CRLIMIT AS LimitAmount
		,CASE
            WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP = 0 THEN '19000101' ELSE BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP END AS [LimitEndTimestamp]
		,BCC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,BCC.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
		,BCCD.RECORD_STATUS
	FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACCP_DELTA BCCD
	LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACCP BCC
	ON BCCD.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR = BCC.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR AND BCCD.CRDACCT_NBR = BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AND BCC.isLatest = '1'
	
	UNION ALL
	
	-- Last Credit Limit -- CRDACCT_DTE_LST_CREDIT_LIMIT -- CRDACCT_LST_CRLIMIT 
	SELECT
		BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AS CustomerAccountId
		,'Last Credit Limit' AS LimitTypeId
		,CASE
			WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT = 0 THEN '19000101' ELSE BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT END AS [Timestamp]
		,BCC.CRDACCT_LST_CRLIMIT AS LimitAmount
		,CASE
            WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP = 0 THEN '19000101' ELSE BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP END AS [LimitEndTimestamp]
		,BCC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,BCC.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
		,BCCD.RECORD_STATUS
	FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACCP_DELTA BCCD
	LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACCP BCC
	ON BCCD.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR = BCC.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR AND BCCD.CRDACCT_NBR = BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AND BCC.isLatest = '1'
	
	UNION ALL
	
	-- Cash Credit Limit -- CRDACCT_TIME_MAINT -- CRDACCT_CASHLIMIT 
	SELECT
		BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AS CustomerAccountId
		,'Cash Credit Limit' AS LimitTypeId
		,CASE
			WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT = 0 THEN '19000101' ELSE BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT END AS [Timestamp]
		,BCC.CRDACCT_CASHLIMIT AS LimitAmount
		,CASE
            WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP = 0 THEN '19000101' ELSE BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP END AS [LimitEndTimestamp]
		,BCC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,BCC.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
		,BCCD.RECORD_STATUS
	FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACCP_DELTA BCCD
	LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACCP BCC
	ON BCCD.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR = BCC.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR AND BCCD.CRDACCT_NBR = BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AND BCC.isLatest = '1'
	
	UNION ALL
	
	-- Installment Limit -- CRDACCT_TIME_MAINT -- CRDACCT_INSTL_LMT 
	SELECT
		BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AS CustomerAccountId
		,'Installment Limit' AS LimitTypeId
		,CASE
			WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT = 0 THEN '19000101' ELSE BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT END AS [Timestamp]
		,BCC.CRDACCT_INSTL_LMT AS LimitAmount
		,CASE
            WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP = 0 THEN '19000101' ELSE BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP END AS [LimitEndTimestamp]
		,BCC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,BCC.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
		,BCCD.RECORD_STATUS
	FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACCP_DELTA BCCD
	LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACCP BCC
	ON BCCD.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR = BCC.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR AND BCCD.CRDACCT_NBR = BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AND BCC.isLatest = '1'
) DAILY

UNION ALL

SELECT * FROM (
	
	-- Credit Limit -- CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT -- CRDACCT_CRLIMIT
	SELECT
		BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AS CustomerAccountId
		,'Credit Limit' AS LimitTypeId
		,CASE
			WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT = 0 THEN '19000101' ELSE BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT END AS [Timestamp]
		,BCC.CRDACCT_CRLIMIT AS LimitAmount
		,CASE
            WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP = 0 THEN '19000101' ELSE BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP END AS [LimitEndTimestamp]
		,BCC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,BCC.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
		,BCCD.RECORD_STATUS
	FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACFP_DELTA BCCD
	LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACFP BCC
	ON BCCD.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR = BCC.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR AND BCCD.CRDACCT_NBR = BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AND BCC.isLatest = '1'
	
	UNION ALL
	
	-- Temporary Credit Limit -- CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EFF -- CRDACCT_TEMP_CRLIMIT
	SELECT
		BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AS CustomerAccountId
		,'Temporary Credit Limit' AS LimitTypeId
		,CASE
			WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT = 0 THEN '19000101' ELSE BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT END AS [Timestamp]
		,BCC.CRDACCT_TEMP_CRLIMIT AS LimitAmount
		,CASE
            WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP = 0 THEN '19000101' ELSE BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP END AS [LimitEndTimestamp]
		,BCC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,BCC.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
		,BCCD.RECORD_STATUS
	FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACFP_DELTA BCCD
	LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACFP BCC
	ON BCCD.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR = BCC.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR AND BCCD.CRDACCT_NBR = BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AND BCC.isLatest = '1'
	
	UNION ALL
	
	-- Permanent Credit Limit -- CRDACCT_TIME_MAINT -- CRDACCT_PERM_CRLIMIT 
	SELECT
		BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AS CustomerAccountId
		,'Permanent Credit Limit' AS LimitTypeId
		,CASE
			WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT = 0 THEN '19000101' ELSE BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT END AS [Timestamp]
		,BCC.CRDACCT_PERM_CRLIMIT AS LimitAmount
		,CASE
            WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP = 0 THEN '19000101' ELSE BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP END AS [LimitEndTimestamp]
		,BCC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,BCC.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
		,BCCD.RECORD_STATUS
	FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACFP_DELTA BCCD
	LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACFP BCC
	ON BCCD.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR = BCC.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR AND BCCD.CRDACCT_NBR = BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AND BCC.isLatest = '1'
	
	UNION ALL
	
	-- Last Credit Limit -- CRDACCT_DTE_LST_CREDIT_LIMIT -- CRDACCT_LST_CRLIMIT 
	SELECT
		BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AS CustomerAccountId
		,'Last Credit Limit' AS LimitTypeId
		,CASE
			WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT = 0 THEN '19000101' ELSE BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT END AS [Timestamp]
		,BCC.CRDACCT_LST_CRLIMIT AS LimitAmount
		,CASE
            WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP = 0 THEN '19000101' ELSE BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP END AS [LimitEndTimestamp]
		,BCC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,BCC.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
		,BCCD.RECORD_STATUS
	FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACFP_DELTA BCCD
	LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACFP BCC
	ON BCCD.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR = BCC.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR AND BCCD.CRDACCT_NBR = BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AND BCC.isLatest = '1'
	
	UNION ALL
	
	-- Cash Credit Limit -- CRDACCT_TIME_MAINT -- CRDACCT_CASHLIMIT 
	SELECT
		BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AS CustomerAccountId
		,'Cash Credit Limit' AS LimitTypeId
		,CASE
			WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT = 0 THEN '19000101' ELSE BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT END AS [Timestamp]
		,BCC.CRDACCT_CASHLIMIT AS LimitAmount
		,CASE
            WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP = 0 THEN '19000101' ELSE BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP END AS [LimitEndTimestamp]
		,BCC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,BCC.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
		,BCCD.RECORD_STATUS
	FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACFP_DELTA BCCD
	LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACFP BCC
	ON BCCD.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR = BCC.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR AND BCCD.CRDACCT_NBR = BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AND BCC.isLatest = '1'
	
	UNION ALL
	
	-- Installment Limit -- CRDACCT_TIME_MAINT -- CRDACCT_INSTL_LMT 
	SELECT
		BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AS CustomerAccountId
		,'Installment Limit' AS LimitTypeId
		,CASE
			WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT = 0 THEN '19000101' ELSE BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_CURR_CREDIT_LIMIT END AS [Timestamp]
		,BCC.CRDACCT_INSTL_LMT AS LimitAmount
		,CASE
            WHEN BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP = 0 THEN '19000101' ELSE BCC.CRDACCT_DTE_TEMP_CRLIMIT_EXP END AS [LimitEndTimestamp]
		,BCC.BNK_CODE AS FinancialInstitutionId
		,'CCD' AS SourceSystemCode
		,0 AS TaskRunId
		,0 AS WorkFlowId
		,BCC.INSERT_DTTM AS InsertDttm
		,BCCD.RECORD_STATUS
	FROM BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACFP_DELTA BCCD
	LEFT JOIN BUSC.CCD_CBCEXCACFP BCC
	ON BCCD.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR = BCC.CRDACCT_CUST_NBR AND BCCD.CRDACCT_NBR = BCC.CRDACCT_NBR AND BCC.isLatest = '1'
	) MONTHLY
)A
)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT FROM TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT WHERE RN = 1 AND CustomerAccountId IS NOT NULL;



WITH TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT_SRC AS (
    SELECT 
        HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
				CustomerAccountId
				,LimitTypeId
				,[Timestamp]
				,LimitAmount
				,LimitEndTimestamp
				)) AS HASHROW
        ,CustomerAccountId
		,RECORD_STATUS
    FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT
    WHERE RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
)

,
TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT_TGT AS (
    SELECT  
        HASHBYTES('MD5', CONCAT(
				CustomerAccountId
				,LimitTypeId
				,[Timestamp]
				,LimitAmount
				,LimitEndTimestamp
				)) AS HASHROW
        ,CustomerAccountId
    FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountLimit
	WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'CCD'
)

,
TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT_DELTA AS (
	SELECT	
		SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
		,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
		,ISNULL(SRC.CustomerAccountId,TGT.CustomerAccountId) AS CustomerAccountId
		,CASE
			WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
		ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
	
FROM TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT_SRC	SRC
FULL OUTER JOIN TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT_TGT	TGT
ON	SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW 
)


SELECT * INTO #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT_DELTA FROM TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT_DELTA;


UPDATE TGT 
SET
[CustomerAccountId] = SRC.CustomerAccountId
,[LimitTypeId] = SRC.LimitTypeId
,[Timestamp] = convert(date,convert(varchar,SRC.Timestamp))
,[LimitAmount] = SRC.LimitAmount
,[LimitEndTimestamp] = convert(date,convert(varchar,SRC.LimitEndTimestamp))
,[FinancialInstitutionId] = SRC.FinancialInstitutionId
,[SourceSystemCode] = 'CCD'
,[TaskRunId] = 0
,[WorkFlowId] = 0
,[InsertDttm] = getDate()
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountLimit TGT 
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT_DELTA DELTA ON DELTA.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId AND DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT SRC ON SRC.CustomerAccountId = TGT.CustomerAccountId ;


INSERT INTO BNKM.CustomerAccountLimit (
	[CustomerAccountId]
	,[LimitTypeId]
	,[Timestamp]
	,[LimitAmount]
	,[LimitEndTimestamp]
	,[FinancialInstitutionId]
	,[SourceSystemCode]
	,[TaskRunId]
	,[WorkFlowId]
	,[InsertDttm])

SELECT     
	[CustomerAccountId]
	,[LimitTypeId]
	,convert(date,convert(varchar,Timestamp)) AS [Timestamp]
	,[LimitAmount]
	,convert(date,convert(varchar,LimitEndTimestamp)) AS [LimitEndTimestamp]
	,[FinancialInstitutionId]
	,[SourceSystemCode]
	,[TaskRunId]
	,[WorkFlowId]
	,[InsertDttm]
FROM #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT
WHERE RECORD_STATUS in ('INSERT');


DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT;
DROP TABLE #TEMP_BNKM_CUSTOMERACCOUNTLIMIT_DELTA;

END
